title: Writing contest: day 2 sub-plots
question: Which writer should lead creative writing? Each wrote three day-2 sub-plots with full dialogue from the same brief (contest/day2/BRIEF.md). Comment on each sub-plot if you like; who is who is revealed after you send.

decision: B (Codex) leads creative writing. B: clearer scenes, but too verbose, too many steps and detours. A (Claude): tries too hard to be funny, unclear situation. A welcome party at the end of the day is a good idea.
